claim: The Dark Gift pool has two distinct layers: which minion can be offered and which gift can be paired with that minion.

Minion eligibility follows turn-based Tavern Tier bands plus mechanic and named-minion exclusions, while gift eligibility follows turn windows, minion compatibility, lobby/prior-use conditions, and the special Tras'tath subset.
